description: Reconstruction uses projected flags without the greedy directive or a diagnostic lean.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy elision-only
%rule text (w ≻ missing) | old | c
%rule(leftmost-longest) w X [+T]
%rule missing M N
%rule old [+U] X
%rule(leftmost-longest) c r T
%rule r X e
%rule e ε
